title: Define bootstrap ISO contract and boot stages
description: Document and validate the initrd→stage-2 contract: GPG/YubiKey unlock, SOPS material availability, SSH startup, Tailscale startup, runtime identity, and cleanup. Identify which current ISO modules remain and which are rescue-only.
closeReason: Contract implemented and verified: documented initrd-to-stage-2 unlock/SOPS/SSH/network startup and cleanup; QEMU confirmed failed-unlock shutdown, YubiKey unlock, runtime identity, SSH and Tailscale behavior. Replacement Tailscale auth-key acceptance and physical rescue-wifi-up remain tracked in their own follow-up gates.

title: Implement unique runtime rescue hostname
description: Add a deterministic runtime identifier from DMI UUID, machine-id, or MAC fallback; derive a collision-resistant rescue hostname and use it for Tailscale without baking per-host identity into the ISO.
closeReason: Runtime identity is implemented in the ISO modules using DMI UUID, machine-id, then MAC fallback and a hashed rescue hostname; the hostname is passed to tailscale up. QEMU validation joined node rescue-c401d8ec88 and tailscale ssh to it succeeded.

title: Harden ephemeral Tailscale authentication flow
description: Move decrypted Tailscale auth material to /run, gate decryption behind the YubiKey/GPG flow, use restricted rescue tags, start Tailscale after prerequisites, and remove plaintext auth material after successful authentication.
closeReason: User confirmed live rescue ISO/Tailscale/SSH access for nanoserver-01 and miniserver-01/-02/-03. Existing implementation gates SOPS auth material behind the YubiKey flow, invokes tailscale up with a file-backed key and tag:rescue, starts after prerequisite services, and removes the key file after successful authentication.

title: Add disko and nixos-facter-backed install target
description: Completed 2026-10-05. Miniserver-01/-02/-03 each expose A and slot-B configurations. All six NixOS toplevel configurations and all six corresponding `checks.x86_64-linux.nixos-miniserver-*` outputs build/pass against published nix-lib 6a0d3de. Credential-free evaluation confirms every A/B profile uses `/etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key` as its SOPS age SSH identity and persists both private/public host-key files under `/persist`. The three miniserver repeat-destroy Disko QEMU layout checks plus Nanoserver baseline pass; they exercise the shared layout fixture, while slot-B system/check outputs are separately verified. Facter hardware data remains sanitized. No physical devices touched. Actual profile boot/SOPS runtime and Tailnet auth-key use remain under nix-config-27be; per-server Tailnet auth keys must be user-provisioned in nix-secrets.

title: Integrate rescue ISO installation workflow
description: Nanoserver-01 workflow: pass entry hosts/nanoserver-01/ssh_host_ed25519_key was staged under /run mode 0600 after operator YubiKey unlock; private/public pair validated without output. N-A v1.13.0 default failed before Disko on undefined nix.settings.substituters; retry with --no-use-machine-substituters progressed but Tailnet SSH denied root@rescue-4f8e903d48. Direct LAN SSH timed out. Read-only checks confirm rescue remains on tmpfs and all four target disks/partitions unchanged. Staging key cleaned. No Tailnet auth key consumed. Need supported root-capable SSH route. Operational command-surface plan is docs/plans/nixos-operational-command-surface.md in nix-repos.

title: Test rescue ISO in QEMU and on multiple simultaneous boots
description: Build and boot the ISO in QEMU, exercise YubiKey present/absent and auth failure paths, verify unique Tailscale hostnames across concurrent boots, validate secret cleanup, and test the destructive install path only against disposable disks.

title: Fix Disko QEMU repeat-destroy cleanup for nested appliance mounts
description: RESOLVED 2026-10-05 in the project-owned disposable QEMU test harness. Added a test-only 128MiB tmpfs mount at /mnt (including mkdir -p because /mnt is absent in the VM), then two full format/mount/assert/unmount cycles and two confirmed Disko destroy invocations after each cycle. `umount -Rv /mnt` now recursively removes nested Btrfs mounts and the parent test mount before destruction; production Disko layout/configuration is unchanged. Verification passed with command-local nix-lib override: `nix build --no-link --no-write-lock-file --override-input nix-lib path:/home/rona/Repositories/RogerNavelsaker/nix-lib .#checks.x86_64-linux.miniserver-01-disko-layout`, same for `miniserver-02-disko-layout`, `miniserver-03-disko-layout`, and `nanoserver-01-disko-layout`. Changed test file passes `nixfmt --check`; `git diff --check` passes. The isolated namespace probe established that the generic unmount failure occurs when /mnt itself is not mounted. This validates project layout repeatability on disposable QEMU, not physical devices. The full `formatCheck` remains blocked by unrelated pre-existing `devshells/default.nix` formatting.

title: Remove unsupported systemd-sysupdate Verify keys
description: On systemd 259, Verify=yes in the appliance transfer [Source] sections is ignored and logs an unknown-key warning. Runtime testing confirmed SHA256SUMS.gpg is nevertheless fetched and verified using /etc/systemd/import-pubring.gpg. Remove the unsupported keys, keep public-keyring verification covered by the slot-UKI test, and include this cleanup with the next per-host image-version increment; never replace content under an already-published version.

title: Build unified Nanoserver/miniserver hypervisor and GitOps platform
description: Implement shared QEMU/KVM+libvirt, Podman, and K3s host features across nanoserver-01 and the three miniservers. K3s roles: three miniserver embedded-etcd servers; Nanoserver worker. Use Flux for GitOps, SOPS token protection, persistent NVMe-backed state, CI evaluation/build/asset-size gate. Plan: docs/plans/nanoserver-miniserver-platform.md. No live deployment or disk operations without explicit authorization.
